column1: Equifax is refusing to remove inaccurate information from my credit report after I disputed it multiple times.
Debt collectors from ABC Agency are calling my family and threatening legal action over a paid medical debt.
I applied for a personal installment loan but was denied due to a credit check error, and they charged me an application fee anyway.
My mortgage servicer XYZ Bank incorrectly applied my payment to late fees instead of principal, leading to higher interest charges.
A collection agency reported a fake debt to my credit bureau, ruining my score for a home loan.
